findings.title: An old state command retry can reactivate a later paused goal
findings.trigger: An active transition commits and its response is lost; a later authorized pause commits; the earlier caller retransmits the same active request.
findings.invariant_broken: Blueprint GoalService.transition expected revision and common mutable-pointer compare-and-set/idempotent command ordering. A retry must not supply renewed authority or reverse a newer pause.
findings.reproduction: Real PostgreSQL on an exclusively named disposable database migrated to published HEAD: paused -> active (lost response) -> paused -> duplicate active. Final state is active and goal revision remains unchanged. Existing public DTO accepts state alone.
findings.repair_requirement: Require exact current goal revision plus a monotonic state revision, actor/input-bound immutable command key/receipt, atomic projection/event/receipt writes, SQL transition guard, and API/SDK/CLI parity. Exact receipt retry returns its historic result; competing stale commands conflict.

findings.title: Unsupported canonical context schemas inherit legacy authorization
findings.trigger: A stored context payload uses an unknown or missing schema version while retaining common fixture-only fields and a current baseline reference.
findings.invariant_broken: Unknown schema cannot be treated as compatible authoritative immutable context; missing typed authority/identity/deadline data must hold execution.
findings.reproduction: Actual PostgreSQL accepts a RunContext.local.v99 canonical context and cycle/outbox. CycleOutbox.consume returns recorded rather than held. A pure probe also returns True for {}, local.v99 and GoalSpec.local.v2 without any current-authority read.
findings.limits: No public DTO bypass demonstrated. Normal goal/admission code generates recognized typed contexts. Reproduction requires malformed/unsupported canonical row insertion, a privilege already needed by fixture application roles, or a future unqualified writer. Production is disabled.
findings.repair_requirement: Explicitly identify supported legacy payload versions, validate recognized typed V2/V3 contexts fail closed, and reject unknown/missing/malformed schemas. Preserve genuine V1 compatibility: historical context column is RunContext.local.v1 but payload schema_version is GoalSpec.local.v1.
